title: Adaptive Sampling Strategies to Construct Equitable Training Datasets
reasoning: The paper's central thesis is the operationalization of ethical principles, specifically fairness and equity, into the technical process of dataset construction. It develops a framework where stakeholders can encode their ethical preferences (e.g., prioritizing underserved groups) into a utility function to guide the data sampling process. This constitutes a deep and foundational engagement with applied ethics in machine learning, rather than a superficial discussion.
